title: Conversation Lesson 1: At the Restaurant
situation: You are at a restaurant and want to order food, but you have a peanut allergy. You need to communicate this to the waiter.

dialogue.speaker: Waiter
dialogue.text: Good evening! Are you ready to order?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Yes, I am. But before I order, I need to let you know that I have a severe peanut allergy. Does the Pad Thai contain peanuts?

dialogue.speaker: Waiter
dialogue.text: Yes, our traditional Pad Thai is garnished with crushed peanuts. However, we can definitely make it without them for you.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: That would be great, thank you. Could you also ensure that it's cooked in a separate pan to avoid cross-contamination?

dialogue.speaker: Waiter
dialogue.text: Absolutely, I will make a special note for the kitchen. Would you like anything to drink?
